general.title: OMIX GSVA
general.instructions:
Gene Set Variation Analysis (GSVA) for expression data.

**To test with example data:** Leave file parameters blank and click Run.
**To use your own data:** Upload normalized expression data, sample metadata, and pathways database files (TSV/CSV/RDS formats supported).

categories.name: 📁 Input Data
categories.help_text: Upload your expression data, sample metadata, and gene set database

categories.name: ⚙️ Basic Settings
categories.help_text: Core analysis parameters including species and gene set collections

categories.name: 🧬 Method Options
categories.help_text: GSVA algorithm and geneset size filtering

parameters.name: Normalized Expression Data
parameters.help_text: TSV/CSV/RDS file with genes in rows and samples in columns. Leave blank to use example data.

parameters.name: Sample Metadata Table
parameters.help_text: TSV/CSV/RDS file with sample annotations. Must include sample names matching expression data columns.

parameters.name: Pathways Database
parameters.help_text: TSV/CSV/RDS file with gene set definitions. Leave blank to use MSigDB v2023.2.

parameters.name: Gene Column Name
parameters.help_text: Column name containing gene identifiers in the normalized data.

parameters.name: Sample Name Column
parameters.help_text: Column name containing sample identifiers in the metadata table.

parameters.name: Data Species
parameters.help_text: Species annotation for genes in your normalized expression data.

parameters.name: Database Species
parameters.help_text: Species for gene sets in the pathways database (MSigDB supports Human and Mouse).

parameters.name: Gene Set Collections
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated list of MSigDB collections (e.g., 'H: hallmark gene sets, C2: curated gene sets').

parameters.name: GSVA Method
parameters.help_text: Statistical method for enrichment scoring. GSVA (default) is most commonly used.

parameters.name: Minimum Geneset Size
parameters.help_text: Gene sets with fewer genes will be excluded from analysis.

parameters.name: Maximum Geneset Size
parameters.help_text: Gene sets with more genes will be excluded from analysis.

parameters.name: Update Gene Symbols
parameters.help_text: Update outdated gene symbols to current nomenclature using l2psupp package.
